changelog: Replace: the trade form's old single pre-entry section (setup grade + one emotion + three justification-prompt textareas) is replaced by a three-phase trade journal — pre-entry, during-position (optional), and post-close — nine questions total, only three free text, grounded in Mark Douglas and Fenton-O'Creevy et al. (2011)

Add: trade_journal / trade_journal_actions tables (migration 2026_09_15_0001), one journal row per trade per phase, with its own created_at/updated_at — an edit never touches created_at, and retrospective self-report timing is exactly what this is for
Add: the during-position phase has no 'skipped' marker by design — an absent row means the trader never returned to the chart mid-trade, which is itself the signal, not a gap to flag

Add: includes/journal_taxonomy.php is the single source of truth for the during-phase multi-select actions and the post-close exit-type codes, same pattern as emotion_states.php — codes stored, never labels
Move: the strategy selector now sits near the top of the trade form (right after Pair), since it determines which gate/tag variables render below it

Fix: trades.note_saw/note_why/note_unsure and emotion_tag are no longer written by the form but the columns and their historical content are kept — nothing is migrated or rewritten. Historical trades still render the old notes under their original question wording, and the new Trade Journal block, wherever a trade's detail view is opened

Note: the separate pre-trade checklist popup (gate variables only, shown before the trade modal opens) still uses the challenge's single default strategy rather than a per-trade choice — a known, deliberately out-of-scope gap for this release, documented in CLAUDE.md
Note: ReviewEngineController does not yet read trade_journal — this release is capture only, analysis is a future release
